results.title: [Hiring] Web Developer Needed to Build a Website — $50 Budget
results.description:
I'm looking to hire a freelance web developer to build a website for me.

Requirements:

- Clean, modern, and professional design

- Fully responsive and mobile-friendly

- Good UI/UX

- Clean, maintainable code

- Source code and full ownership upon completion

Budget: $50 fixed

To apply, please DM me with:

- Your portfolio or examples o

notice: Date publice, fără verificarea identității sau a bugetului. Nu reprezintă contracte confirmate. Nu s-au trimis oferte sau mesaje. Lista zilnică este publică pe GitHub.
